title: Questions 153-154 refer to the following text-message chain.
passage_1:
Nadia Ferraro (10:45 A.M.)
Hi, Tobi. Do you have a moment right now?

Tobi Adeyemi (10:46 A.M.)
I’m heading out to a site visit, but I can spare a couple of minutes. What’s up?

Nadia Ferraro (10:48 A.M.)
Registration for the Sustainable Design Summit closes tomorrow at 6:00 P.M. Do you still want to go with me?

Tobi Adeyemi (10:49 A.M.)
Remind me why it matters for us?

Nadia Ferraro (10:51 A.M.)
The main theme is bringing low-carbon materials into residential work. There is also a session on modular assembly that lines up exactly with one of the projects we are starting.

Tobi Adeyemi (10:52 A.M.)
Oh, right. We discussed it at the team meeting last month. It clearly matches what we are aiming for. Go ahead and register us both.

Nadia Ferraro (10:53 A.M.)
Will do. I’ll put the fees on the corporate card and forward the invoice to finance this morning.
